text.p: Gensia Inc said Wednesday its shareholders approved the acquisition of three specialty pharmaceutical companies and a restructuring of the company.

Gensia said in a statement shareholders approved the issuance of 29.5 million shares of Gensia common stock and the payment of $100,000 in cash to Rakepoll Finance N.V. to acquire Rakepoll Holding B.V.
Rakepoll Holding is the the parent company of Societa Italiana Corticosteroidi S.p.A. of Italy (Sicor), and two Mexican companies Lemery S.A. de C.V. and Sintesis Lerma S.A. de C.V.

Rakepoll Holding will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Gensia. Gensia stockholders also approved changing the name of Gensia to Gensia Sicor Inc as well as increasing the number of authorized shares of Gensia common stock to 125 million from 75 million.

The board of directors of Gensia Sicor will consist of ten members; five will be independent directors chosen jointly by Rakepoll Finance and Gensia management directors, three will be appointed by Rakepoll Finance and two will be appointed by Gensia management.
The acquisition is expected to close at the end of February.
Gensia Sicor, headquartered in San Diego, California, will be a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the worldwide oncology and injectable pharmaceutical markets.
